summary: Legs A day. Today's cafeteria menu is lighter on hot entrees than usual (no chicken/curry/cod dishes), so lunch leans on extra chicken breast plus pasta and a quinoa salad for carbs and fiber. Dinner swaps in smoked duck lo mein for protein-source variety and leg-day carbs, topped off with more chicken breast and pasta.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Eggs, turkey, oats, bread, banana and chia for a balanced protein/carb start before lifting.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: No hot chicken entree today, so extra chicken breast from the salad bar is the main, backed by pasta, quinoa salad and beans for carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: wellness protein smoothie, half bagel, turkey.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Smoked duck lo mein as the protein-forward main for variety and leg-day carbs, extra chicken breast and pasta to close out post-workout protein and carbs.
